slice: P8/S8.2c DXF plot-style default identity under reference resolution

sourceProfile.entityGraph: Runtime-generated associative HATCH and boundary entities, read back and exported again through the dx_iface test adapter.

failure.reproduction: The first write succeeded, import succeeded, then the second write failed in both encodings when the active resolver returned source identity F for each layer's group-390 plot-style reference.
failure.cause: The writer routed source handle F through the generic nondefault plot-style branch and rejected the resolver's final identity because F was also the output's valid Normal placeholder.

change.detail: Resolve source F once. Permit an explicit identity result only if the generated default placeholder is still F and no caller placeholder conflicts. Treat a different resolved handle as a regular graph edge and continue rejecting null, invalid, or default-placeholder targets.

validation.result: PASS; generated HATCH reference/path controls cover ASCII and binary first-write/read-write paths, preplanning/resolver combinations, backward/detached forms, refusal and same-codec retry, plus patterned multi-path HATCH.

testMaintenance.detail: Updated generated DXF class expectations to include ACDBDICTIONARYWDFLT and ACDBPLACEHOLDER emitted by the valid default plot-style graph. ACDS multi-projection, typed ACDS BOX, and EvaluationGraph readbacks now assert these registrations rather than treating them as unexpected extras.
testMaintenance.failureDiagnostics: Added case labels for HATCH primary, read/write, backward, rollback, and retry failures, and prints actual class rows when ACDS/EvaluationGraph assertions fail.

fixturePolicy: Vectors are generated at runtime and retained only under /private/tmp for this local run. No external or repository DWG/DXF fixture was added.
limits: This resolves one default-placeholder identity path and updates local generated-output expectations; broader resolver coverage remains open.
The test is same-library DXF output/readback evidence, not independent CAD interoperability or native UI qualification.
No DWG/DXF family or version support claim is promoted.
